reference.text: Upon this every soul was confounded; for the phenomenon just then observed by Ahab had unaccountably escaped every one else; but its very blinding palpableness must have been the cause.
thou mightest well be taken now for the sea-chariot of the sun.
Mr. Starbuck, last night’s thunder turned our compasses—that’s all.
